shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "--- next.config ---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "--- tsconfig ---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
cd /workspace/app && for f in UserProfile.tsx ProductList.tsx page.tsx layout.tsx; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat -n $f; done

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && ls -R | head -60; echo "=== find cacheComponents ==="; grep -rl "cacheComponents" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20

(npx next dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; done; sleep 2; echo "=== PAGE HTML ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '<body>.*</body>' | head -5; echo; echo "=== full body dump ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | sed -n 's/.*<body>\(.*\)<\/body>.*/\1/p' | head -20
echo "=== dev.log ==="; tail -30 /tmp/dev.log; echo "=== raw html (first 2000 chars) ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -c 2000

curl -s http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/page.html; echo "=== grep for content ==="; grep -o 'Dashboard\|Loading profile[^<]*\|Could not load profile\|Sample Product\|

Profile

\|Products' /tmp/page.html | sort | uniq -c
git stash list; echo "--- confirm error is pre-existing: does page.tsx have my edits? ---"; git diff --stat
pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== package.json diff ==="; git diff package.json
git diff tsconfig.json | cat; echo "=== package.json ==="; git diff package.json | cat; echo "=== files changed ==="; git status --short
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "tsc exit: $?"; echo "=== final status ==="; git status --short
rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short; echo "=== final component ==="; cat -n app/UserProfile.tsx
